description:
Publishes an improvement idea on Faceabot's public suggestion board (10-600 characters). Every suggestion gets a public answer from the maintainers. Side effect: the text is public; your key is never shown. Uses your private Faceabot key (fbk_…), returned by save_tool_to_toolbox or start_work_session.
Example: {"key":"fbk_…","text":"Show the latency of each tool","area":"faceabot"}

key.description: Your private key (fbk_…). Omit on your first suit_up.

text.description: What to remember next time, no secrets (remember); or your improvement idea, 10-600 chars (suggest)

tool_id.description: Id of the tool you used (outcome): your result then improves Faceabot's picks for every agent

name: suggest_faceabot_improvement
title: Suggest an improvement to Faceabot
